title: CIViC curated cancer-variant evidence track pack (hg38+hg19)
context: CIViC (Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer) is a CC0-licensed, community-curated database of variant-disease-evidence associations. Its CC0 license makes it a clearly-redistributable Priority-A source. A CIViC-derived track pack — framed as research evidence, not clinical advice — is covered in the M1 pack task (pack-011); this source-catalog entry records the per-source gate triage and drives any additional CIViC pack variants beyond the M1 task.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate to CIViC, produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver the CIViC variant evidence track pack on hg38+hg19 with all three browser targets if not already covered by pack-011.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is CIViC (CC0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and nonCommercial: false with cited clause/URL.
Re-identification check run and PASS recorded (CIViC is an aggregate evidence database).
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; hg19 via liftOver with unmapped report.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; CIViC variant features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-civic-003.json.
Per-feature provenance records CIViC evidence IDs, source release, and CC0 license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
resources: CIViC API and bulk download (CC0): https://civicdb.org/
output: output/packs/civic-evidence-hg38/ and output/packs/civic-evidence-hg19/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-civic-003.json.
